# Clustering v1

<!-- Generated by sdkgen; edit internal/cmd/sdkgen/service_docs.go. -->

clustering/v1 is implemented by this SDK because pinned Gophercloud does not provide it. The resources below follow pinned openstacksdk and the official API contracts through one authenticated service object. Connection manages authentication, region, endpoint interface and TLS.

Service access: `conn.ClusteringV1(ctx)` (openstacksdk: `conn.clustering`). Responses keep original fields, HTTP headers and status codes.

Package docs describe the service and each resource (`go doc ./clustering/v1/...`). [Identity lookup](finding/README.md), [list controls](listing/README.md), [waits](waiting/README.md), [tracking](tracking/README.md) and [update scopes](scoping/README.md) cover behavior shared by several resources.

## Go usage

```go
// Inside a function with context.Context ctx and *openstack.Connection conn.
service, err := conn.ClusteringV1(ctx)
if err != nil { return err }
for value, err := range service.ProfileTypes.Resources.List(ctx) {
    if err != nil { return err }
    fmt.Println(value)
}
value, err := service.ProfileTypes.Resources.Find(ctx, resource.Name("example"))
if err != nil { return err }
_ = value
```

Examples use `fmt` and `github.com/JSYoo5B/go-openstacksdk/resource`.
